place.name: Grímsey
place.description: Grímsey (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈkrimsˌeiː] ) is a small Icelandic island, 40 kilometres (20 nautical miles) off the north coast of the main island of Iceland, where it straddles the Arctic Circle. Grímsey is also known for the puffins and other sea birds which visit the island for breeding.
